tools.name: find_products_by_constraints
tools.description: Search the Jennifer Furniture catalog by category, budget (e.g. under $4000), material, features, and stock availability.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Fetch full technical specifications, parsed dimensions, materials, care instructions, and variant matrix for a product.

tools.name: check_variant_availability
tools.description: Verify whether a specific variant option combination (Color, Size, Layout) is currently in stock with live quantities.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Generate an aligned side-by-side specification comparison matrix for 2 to 4 products across dimensions, materials, and price.

tools.name: create_checkout_handoff
tools.description: Convert selected product variants into an instant 1-click Shopify direct-to-checkout Cart Permalink URL with discounts.

tools.name: calculate_room_fit_and_clearance
tools.description: Calculate whether a sofa or sectional fits a room with 30-36 inch walking clearance verification.

tools.name: generate_room_floorplan
tools.description: Generates an architectural 2D SVG spatial layout showing wall perimeter, walking clearances, and sofa bounds.

tools.name: match_fabric_and_lighting
tools.description: Harmonizes room wall paint and window sunlight exposure with manufacturer upholstery fabrics.

tools.name: get_product_ar_model
tools.description: Provides Apple QuickLook (.usdz) and Android (.glb) 3D augmented reality model placement links.

tools.name: compare_products_deep_matrix
tools.description: Side-by-side spec comparison matrix across frame materials, fabrics, dimensions, and warranty.

tools.name: build_coordinated_room_bundle
